about: Signed-in chatgpt.com (desktop browser, 'linear' appearance preset, dark mode), captured 2026-11-11 from a new empty chat. Style data only: <html> theme attributes (no account/user ids), every custom-property rule in theme scopes (:root, [data-theme], [data-appearance-preset]) plus component rules that re-declare the bubble/send variables, colour declarations that are exactly var(--x) for accent/bubble/composer/link variables, and var() aliases. 'reconstructed.legacySheet' is hand-written: an old-shell stylesheet that still declares the legacy names (seen on a conversation page, values not captured).
